name: tracing-beam
blurb: Animated vertical beam that traces down the page following scroll progress.
description: A scroll-linked vertical beam with animated gradient that traces from top to bottom. Includes an animated dot and SVG path responding to scroll velocity with spring physics.
use_when: A timeline or step-by-step guide section where visual progress tracking enhances the narrative.
avoid_when: When you need horizontal layouts or when motion might be distracting.
a11y: SVG is decorative (aria-hidden). Children are fully accessible. Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
